scene: 06:10 in the yard, where there is no signal at all. The app is opened cold and rebuilds its screens from the device before anything else happens; the four screens are read as the rebuild left them. The same four are then opened again a screen at a time, the way a crew member who taps straight into one of them from the shift list arrives. One of the four rounds and one job were left with the depot refusing them the night before.
